description: B1 off-map off-by-one: two human ARMATLAS (3x3 footprint) hovering by patrol at Two Continents' east edge (W = 672 cells), one whose footprint ENDS on the last column (x = 10728, footprint cells 669..671) and a control one column in (x = 10712, 668..670), with an AI CORFLAK 330 wu west. Stock's stamp 0x47CC30 parks a unit with X + fw >= W in the off-map bucket (0x47CC8B jge), so the edge atlas takes no splash and no direct hits although every cell is on the map. Peek unit+0x82 against *(main+0x142B7) and read HP (u16 +0x108).
